items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Jeff was there because he was living in the saem building with his family.

ctx.x: -- not the place he had in Central Park West.

No, because he had two girls and one boy. And so we started talking a little while, and he had his Chrysler station wagon. So I said, well, when you going to leave -- when you leaving town. He said, you know, Hap, I'll be downtown. Said, why don't you come on by. So -- by all means. And we started to talking, chatting, and I walked with him, bought food for the family, and next time -- I didn't see him in about a year. And talked to Hitler (unintelligible) Jefferson, said, "didn't never hear about Hawk?" I says,…

He says, well, he living downtown, left the family, and didn't treat the family too good, from what Jeff was telling me. But Jeff was there because he was living in the saem building with his family. And they said that hetreat the family so bad, that his wife -- the tenants in the building didn't like it, and they would always look after the kids.
